suite: r1108 Kandil preferences and idle lifecycle
method: Node VM executes the actual shipped Kandil owner, actual memory-fallback UI storage wrapper and onboarding open/close functions. A fake clock models timeout cancellation, intervals and explicitly invoked stale callbacks. Controlled capture/target/bubble propagation and default-action counters exercise wake-event consumption.
limitations: No browser engine, native keyboard/touch synthesis, computed CSS, layout, screen-reader traversal, Android lock/power state, physical microphone or audible output was exercised.
Capture/default-action behavior is a controlled event model, not evidence of real browser event dispatch.
Focus visibility checks use controlled connected/hidden nodes, not rendered geometry.
